question: How does VerOS carry NetKVM from DriverEntry through PnP StartDevice into MiniportInitializeEx, including AllocatedResources and the general-attributes header?
allowedInputs: Reported: VerOS NetKVM serial logs from 2026-11-16 printed NDIS REG, OPT 92 01 002c, ADDMP, FILTER, START, BUSGOT, MAPOK, HDR 9f 02 00e0, and INIT statuses through c000009a after MapIoSpace

Reported: Windows discovery captures on 2026-11-16 reached DIFF END OK for miniport size 0xA0 bytes 06 53 with a called offset 0x10, optional-handlers type 0x92 revision 1 size 0x2C, RegisterDeviceEx named buffers, OpenConfigurationEx type 0xA9, the 0x4A8 handle dump, protocol type 0x95 revision 2 size 0x80 bytes 06 1e, and attributes type 0xA4 revision 1 size 0x14

differential-tests/ndis-discovery/METHOD.md records those same NetKVM and Windows captures, including AllocatedResources at init-parameters offset 8 from public member order and the VerOS-only 9f/2/e0 accept
https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows-hardware/drivers/ddi/ndis/ns-ndis-_ndis_miniport_init_parameters lists Header, then Flags, then AllocatedResources
sdk/include/psdk/ntddndis.h NDIS_OBJECT_HEADER is 4 bytes; Flags is a ULONG, so AllocatedResources is at offset 8 on x64
sdk/include/xdk/cmtypes.h CM_PARTIAL_RESOURCE_LIST Count at offset 4 and PartialResourceList after Count, InterfaceType, and BusNumber
sdk/include/ddk/ndis.h NDIS_RESOURCE_LIST is CM_PARTIAL_RESOURCE_LIST; NDIS_STATUS_RESOURCE_CONFLICT is 0xC001001E
sdk/include/xdk/iotypes.h DRIVER_OBJECT.DriverExtension, AddDevice, MajorFunction, and StartDevice AllocatedResources on the stack
https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows-hardware/drivers/ddi/ndis/nf-ndis-ndismsetminiportattributes names the second attributes structure without giving its type byte
ntoskrnl/ke/processor.c KeNumberProcessors and KeQueryMaximumProcessorCountEx group behavior already in this file
Removed virtio-win driver URLs. The call and the sizes stay on the Learn DDI pages, the in-tree NDIS headers, and the netkvm and ndis-discovery logs already listed.
